payload.text: ccusage herdr install says nothing while herdr-app check runs, and the check can take minutes: on hv's install (vc, 2026-11-13) it took about two, because Herdr runs it as a background GUI job, so install looked hung. check in src/herdr.rs runs Command::output() with no bound. The plan went to vc in words after 0.1.10's publish (2026-11-17), as vc asked: a line on stderr before the check; the wait bounded by one named constant, with a check past it reported as not checked (exit 0) and a failed check still exit 1; the bounded wait a small std-only function, unit-tested against sleep; RECIPE.md, README and the CHANGELOG to match. It is built in the next release, on vc's go, in one worktree and one Desk cargo slot.
